column1: Did you consult with other health care professionals to inform your assessment? Select all that apply.

Explanatory Notes: This chart represents MAID data where the report was received by Health Canada by January 31, 2021. For 2020, this represents 7,384 MAID deaths. "Other physician" included consultations with a wide range of over 20 medical specialties, the most common being neurologists, hospitalists, and respirologists/pulmonologists. Examples of entries in "other consultation" included psychologist, speech pathologist, spiritual care, and bio/medical ethicists.
